headline: US executes limited strikes against Iran as Centcom offers reward
summary: The US military carried out limited strikes against a newly built Iranian air defense unit, while the US military command Centcom offered up to $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear program.
why: Geopolitical tensions involving Iran and the United States directly affect Middle Eastern security and global energy markets.

impacts.name: Iran
impacts.why: US military strikes targeted Iranian air defense installations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Escalating military actions and intelligence rewards regarding Iran raise geopolitical risk premiums in the Middle East.
